caption: The drawing depicts a lidded trophy cup with two ornate handles, rendered in shades of grey pencil on a light background. The cup sits on a round, tiered base and has a wide, rounded body that tapers slightly towards the bottom. The handles are symmetrical, richly decorated with curving lines and scrollwork, extending outward from each side of the cup. The lid of the cup is domed and topped with a finial shaped like a stylized flower bud or fruit. At the center of the cup’s body, there is a detailed crest or coat of arms featuring a shield with cross-hatched quadrants surrounded by elaborate foliate designs and topped with a helmet, indicating heraldic imagery. The entire composition is enclosed within a faint rectangular border. In the bottom right corner, the signature “V. Carano” is present.
title: Silver Cup with Cover
